\subsection{Separate historical repeatability batches}

Existing multi-batch records are a separate endpoint. Each batch contains 50 disjoint rounding seeds on its fixed input. The following ranges describe variation of batch means and native-selected assignments, without treating a single native assignment as having a within-batch SD. They are not independent datasets, and are not new campaign measurements. \subsection{USPS numerical audit on one newly frozen F/W pair}

These rows use a newly generated, recoverable current USPS representation and its exact shrinkage graph. They do not identify or replace the missing historical selected F/G arrays. Every non-SC point targets unsquared E8 with undirected coefficient $2\gamma w$. All original ten stages remain visible; the two additional restarts are separate numerical attempts, not replacements for the historical finite-iteration winner or subset-search output.

The numerical audit and subset USPS representation record exactly matching current F/W content addresses. Recorded input-reference status: MATCHING\_RECORDED\_CURRENT\_F\_W\_OBJECTS. This is only a comparison of current input references. Each certificate belongs to its own saved continuation G; it does not certify the locked IRLS G, establish a certified closest search result, or recover missing historical F/G arrays.

Tables~\ref{tab:usps-numerical-audit} and~\ref{tab:usps-numerical-rounding} refer to the same stage/gamma rows. C/U denote the recorded certified/uncertified state, with a required relative gap at most $10^{-5}$ and capacity violation at most $10^{-8}$ for certification. A solver stopping status alone is not a certificate. Uncertified points cannot establish that the mathematical objective lacks clustering capacity. Missing exports or saved points stay unavailable.

\subsection{Conditional EnSC adaptation: capability and locked operation}

The primary adaptation is the fixed $\tau=.95$ EnSC graph used only as the fusion graph for anchor F0. The source coefficient parameter is 50; graphs are matched to W0 total mass. Capability rows are label-assisted oracles: one complete configuration is selected by mean ACC, then NMI, then stable ID. The primary graph has five declared SSC gamma values; original SSC receives the frozen 15-value path. Controls remain separate named families. The locked operating row uses source 50/$\tau=.95$/SSC gamma 1 without choosing parameters from labels. Both kinds of row use previously examined benchmarks; neither is an unseen-data test.

The native EnSC controls cluster each learned affinity in its own spectral space, with an explicit seeded eigensolver and the same fifty greedy one-start rounds. This differs from the source constructor default of 20 K-means starts. Gains over original SC/SSC must not be credited to SSC shrinkage when the native affinity clustering already explains them. The following differences compare the selected primary $\tau=.95$ + SSC row against matched native $\tau=.95$ EnSC, when both complete rows exist. They are descriptive differences after capability selection, not unbiased intervals or matched-movement evidence.

\paragraph{Separate capability and locked-operation targets.}

Each formal row requires all four prescribed, qualified datasets with equal weights. ACC is compared with the stronger fair-SC/original-SSC baseline on each dataset; the two NMI contrasts retain those same baselines separately. Capability uses label-assisted parameter selection. Locked operation fixes source coefficient 50, $\tau=.95$ and SSC $\gamma=1$ without choosing those parameters from labels. Both tracks are evaluated against the same label-assisted baseline selections, on previously examined benchmarks. Neither success criterion substitutes for the other.

Capability conclusion status: INCOMPLETE\_FOUR\_BENCHMARK\_COMPARISON. Its formal macro and practical-target decision remain NA; partial datasets or unresolved certification/control coverage are not averaged into a result.

Locked-operation conclusion status: INCOMPLETE\_FOUR\_BENCHMARK\_COMPARISON. Its formal macro and practical-target decision remain NA; partial datasets or unresolved certification/control coverage are not averaged into a result.
